mechanism: Gemfibrozil inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C8, potentially increasing chlorpromazine metabolism via CYP2D6 inhibition and displacement from protein binding, elevating chlorpromazine levels.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, orthostatic hypotension); consider chlorpromazine dose reduction if toxicity occurs.
